Hello everyone,

Thanks,

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Total count for each faceted histogram...
parts:
Why not do it yourself:

counts <- as.data.frame(table(mtcars$cyl))
mtcars$cyl2 <- factor(mtcars$cyl,
levels = counts$Var1,
labels = paste(counts$Var1,
"cyl",
"(n =",
counts$Freq,
")"))
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) + geom_point() +
facet_wrap(~cyl2)

?

Best,
Ista
